slides.texte_overlay:
Lessons older men wish
they'd learned at 20
Your health is your real wealth. The knees, back and heart you have at 50 are built by how you treat your body in your 20s. Start training now.
Most worries never happen. Older men say the same thing: they wasted years stressing about problems that never came. Deal with today and let the rest go.
Call your parents more often. One day the phone won't ring back. Ten minutes a week now is something you'll be grateful for forever.
Compound interest works on everything. Money, skills, friendships. Small, steady efforts in your 20s become huge results by your 40s and 50s.
Never stop learning. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and those little lessons add up to a mind that keeps growing.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Those little lessons add up to a mind that keeps growing.

slides.texte_overlay: Choose your partner carefully. The person you build a life with shapes your happiness more than your job, your city or your income.
Nobody is thinking about you as much as you think. Stop worrying about looking foolish. Try things, fail, laugh and try again. Just go.
